reviewer.identifier: Codex, working agent reviewing the authorized revision

src/content/arguments/assessment-as-work.proposition: P-002, P-003, S-003, and S-005 motivate A-001 as a practical assessment strategy through the stated expected-value decision principle.
src/content/arguments/assessment-as-work.qualifiers: The argument now quotes S-005 directly. Even assuming the empirical premises true, some beneficial cases do not establish a matching opportunity and effective input for this person, state, and time.
src/content/arguments/assessment-as-work.evidenceSeparation: Premise confidence remains unresolved separately from the practical inference. The stronger effect claim does not establish detection, predictive selection, or efficacy in asymptomatic people.
src/content/arguments/assessment-as-work.alignment: The summary and premise interpretation now describe actual proposed effects rather than intended alteration. The target, safety, comfort, missed-opportunity, and unsuccessful-input boundaries remain intact.
src/content/arguments/assessment-as-work.inferenceAndImpact: The practical and normative bridge remains explicit, so the inference stays defeasible. A-001 is not inferred from dependency arrows, and no manufactured empirical premise or broader-benefit requirement is added.

src/content/arguments/functional-rationa.proposition: P-001 and P-002 support P-003 through a normative interpretation of a functional aim as legitimate independently of symptoms.
src/content/arguments/functional-rationa.qualifiers: May supply a rationale expresses conceptual permission under the stated scope, not uncertainty smuggled into an empirical effect proposition.
src/content/arguments/functional-rationa.evidenceSeparation: The argument expressly supplies no efficacy premise; particular opportunities, input effects, and outcomes require independent empirical evaluation.
src/content/arguments/functional-rationa.alignment: The philosophical statements and explanations are unchanged. The practical adjustment target remains in A-001 and ARG-002 rather than being attributed to this route.
src/content/arguments/functional-rationa.inferenceAndImpact: The brief premises do not force every scope interpretation, so defeasibility remains appropriate. Stronger Science statements do not turn this philosophical route into a clinical deduction.

src/content/arguments/methodological-syn.proposition: F-001 and F-002 motivate the F-003 authoring method through methodological synthesis.
src/content/arguments/methodological-syn.qualifiers: The route is explicitly defeasible, and the unchanged F-003 statement limits its method to proposed inferences.
src/content/arguments/methodological-syn.evidenceSeparation: Separating evidence from premise truth is part of the method; the argument does not make empirical premises true.
src/content/arguments/methodological-syn.alignment: The existing explanation remains aligned with F-003 after its new proposition/confidence rule because the exact conclusion and methodological roles are unchanged.
src/content/arguments/methodological-syn.inferenceAndImpact: Neither premise makes this the only possible method. No deductive classification, empirical bridge, or dependency-derived argument is introduced.

src/content/arguments/reassessment-after.proposition: A-001 and A-002 motivate A-003 through the practical choice to examine a predicted response before deciding what follows.
src/content/arguments/reassessment-after.qualifiers: A warranted input and comparable conditions delimit the route. The intentional description of A-002 remains accurate even after S-005 becomes an effect claim.
src/content/arguments/reassessment-after.evidenceSeparation: The route acknowledges unvalidated observations and decision thresholds; an observed difference supplies no automatic causal or broader-benefit confirmation.
src/content/arguments/reassessment-after.alignment: The exact premise and conclusion statements are unchanged. Their revised explanations preserve the working-hypothesis and conditional-application account used here.
src/content/arguments/reassessment-after.inferenceAndImpact: The route remains defeasible, requiring informative observations. Withholding the original input leaves no post-application sequence; uninformative reassessment does not justify repeated input.

src/content/model/art/assessment.md.proposition: Assessment is a strategy for developing a working judgment about a present beneficial opportunity and a suitable available input.
src/content/model/art/assessment.md.qualifiers: Can be identified and what, if any, concern assessment capability and the possibility of withholding input. Uncertainty in a person-specific working judgment is appropriate to this strategy.
src/content/model/art/assessment.md.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved confidence concerns unvalidated detection and selection. Real opportunities can be missed, and the text makes no unsupported claim about the frequency of misses.
src/content/model/art/assessment.md.alignment: The main statement and indication boundaries are unchanged. The updated explanation now uses S-005 as an effect hypothesis, not merely an intention; unsuccessful inputs remain evaluable failures.
src/content/model/art/assessment.md.inferenceAndImpact: P-002, P-003, S-003, and S-005 retain distinct normative, conceptual, and practical roles. ARG-002 exposes the person-level bridge. A-002 and A-003 retain conditional action and reassessment despite the stronger empirical premise.

src/content/model/art/chiropractic-appli.proposition: The strategy applies a selected input to test and act on the working assessment hypothesis when proceeding is warranted.
src/content/model/art/chiropractic-appli.qualifiers: When warranted governs action. Intended describes the purpose of this particular application and must remain because S-005 asserts effects only in some cases.
src/content/model/art/chiropractic-appli.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved confidence is compatible with the strategy; delivery alone establishes neither learning nor beneficial reorganization.
src/content/model/art/chiropractic-appli.alignment: The main statement is unchanged. The revised explanation identifies S-005 as the mechanism and effect application seeks to realize, while preserving withholding and the absence of a validated delivery protocol.
src/content/model/art/chiropractic-appli.inferenceAndImpact: A-001 directly supplies selection and S-005 supplies the proposed mechanism and response. A-003 and ARG-003 were reconsidered and remain appropriate for conditional reassessment without assuming this input succeeded.

src/content/model/art/reassessment-cycle.proposition: The practical strategy repeats assessment after input to guide stopping, revision, or a justified subsequent input.
src/content/model/art/reassessment-cycle.qualifiers: Following input and when justified are genuine conditions. May in the explanation distinguishes possible findings rather than weakening an empirical effect claim.
src/content/model/art/reassessment-cycle.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved confidence and the boundary leave measurement validity, causal attribution, and decision thresholds open.
src/content/model/art/reassessment-cycle.alignment: The statement, summary, and body consistently describe hypothesis checking without guaranteeing informative findings or broader benefit.
src/content/model/art/reassessment-cycle.inferenceAndImpact: A-001 and A-002 directly supply the prediction and applied input. Their revised explanations preserve these roles. ARG-003 remains defeasible; feedback into a later assessment cycle is not a same-cycle dependency.

src/content/model/framework/claim-discip.proposition: The framework requires evaluation appropriate to claim kind and separates validity, premise truth, and evidential justification.
src/content/model/framework/claim-discip.qualifiers: Must expresses the authoring requirement. Conditional statements about deduction delimit the evaluation rather than hedge its existence.
src/content/model/framework/claim-discip.evidenceSeparation: Uncertain empirical premise truth leaves soundness unresolved; it neither makes the premise false nor changes the proposition.
src/content/model/framework/claim-discip.alignment: The three evaluations and claim-kind explanation match the statement. No Boolean soundness shortcut or logical claim type is introduced.
src/content/model/framework/claim-discip.inferenceAndImpact: F-001 supplies a methodological dependency; F-003 operationalizes this separation. ARG-001 remains a defeasible methodological synthesis.

src/content/model/framework/explicit-rea.proposition: The Model commits to exposing the premises and inference before independently evaluating empirical premises.
src/content/model/framework/explicit-rea.qualifiers: Where the Model proposes an inference is a scope condition. The new explicit rule preserves scope, capacity, and action conditions while locating confidence separately.
src/content/model/framework/explicit-rea.evidenceSeparation: The new wording permits direct empirical hypotheses with unresolved support; evidence can still require explicit revision of those hypotheses.
src/content/model/framework/explicit-rea.alignment: The main statement is unchanged. The added explanation distinguishes occurrence from possibility and prohibits both unreasoned weakening and strengthening.
src/content/model/framework/explicit-rea.inferenceAndImpact: F-001 and F-002 remain direct methodological inputs; ARG-001 supports the method defeasibly. No scientific conclusion follows merely from stating a stronger premise.

src/content/model/framework/philosophy-s.proposition: A framework commitment assigns connected roles to philosophy, science, and art; it does not assert chiropractic effectiveness.
src/content/model/framework/philosophy-s.qualifiers: Revisable and contextually define the method. Best-supported governs application without claiming the current proposals are established.
src/content/model/framework/philosophy-s.evidenceSeparation: Confidence is not-applicable for the framework. Historical references are explicitly provenance, not empirical authority.
src/content/model/framework/philosophy-s.alignment: The statement, summary, and explanations consistently distinguish reasoning, evidence, and contextual practice.
src/content/model/framework/philosophy-s.inferenceAndImpact: F-002 and F-003 retain methodological dependencies. ARG-001 uses this division of responsibility without presenting the chosen method as necessary.

src/content/model/philosophy/care-beyond.proposition: Symptoms and pathology are not necessary as a rationale for care; the boundary separately specifies the proposed functional target of an adjustment.
src/content/model/philosophy/care-beyond.qualifiers: Non-necessity does not mean sufficient indication. If there is no relevant opportunity, the proposed improvement cannot occur through that target; symptoms can still affect safety and comfort.
src/content/model/philosophy/care-beyond.evidenceSeparation: The framework confidence remains not-applicable. Neither the philosophical rationale nor the target description validates detection, selection, or efficacy.
src/content/model/philosophy/care-beyond.alignment: The indication and assessment boundaries are preserved, including the distinction between absence of opportunity and failure to identify it in A-001.
src/content/model/philosophy/care-beyond.inferenceAndImpact: P-001 and P-002 retain conceptual and normative roles. ARG-004 supports only the rationale; A-001 and ARG-002 handle the practical target and uncertainty independently.

src/content/model/philosophy/functional-.proposition: Open-ended functional potential is a framework starting commitment across circumstances, not a claim of limitless capacity.
src/content/model/philosophy/functional-.qualifiers: Open-ended and possible concern potential. Exclusions of inevitable progress and a present imperfection define its scope rather than hedge an effect claim.
src/content/model/philosophy/functional-.evidenceSeparation: The entry uses not-applicable confidence and expressly separates this commitment from empirical findings about interventions.
src/content/model/philosophy/functional-.alignment: The summary and boundary consistently deny that health status exhausts potential without implying an adjustment opportunity in everyone.
src/content/model/philosophy/functional-.inferenceAndImpact: P-002 and P-003 retain conceptual dependencies. ARG-004 adds the normative interpretation for a rationale; it establishes no chiropractic effect.

src/content/model/philosophy/purpose.md.proposition: Net-positive functional improvement is adopted as a legitimate aim in its own right, a value proposition.
src/content/model/philosophy/purpose.md.qualifiers: A legitimate aim avoids exclusivity. Net-positive defines benefit with costs and tradeoffs; the conditional success example concerns actual functional improvement.
src/content/model/philosophy/purpose.md.evidenceSeparation: Not-applicable confidence fits a value commitment. The boundary distinguishes its proposed empirical account from evidence that an input works.
src/content/model/philosophy/purpose.md.alignment: The statement and explanation consistently value improved function itself without requiring symptom relief or a further downstream benefit.
src/content/model/philosophy/purpose.md.inferenceAndImpact: P-001 supplies conceptual scope. P-003 and A-001 use the normative aim; S-003, S-005, and S-006 use benefit criteria conceptually. S-005 no longer uses the aim merely to justify intent. ARG-002 and ARG-004 remain defeasible.

src/content/model/science/broader-functi.proposition: The approved hypothesis asserts that some chiropractic-produced neuromotor changes contribute to broader net-positive functional benefit.
src/content/model/science/broader-functi.qualifiers: May is deliberately removed to assert occurrence. Some retains existential scope; net-positive retains the benefit criterion, without a frequency estimate or guaranteed result.
src/content/model/science/broader-functi.evidenceSeparation: Confidence remains unresolved and the evidence note explicitly says broader beneficial transfer has not been established by evidence documented here.
src/content/model/science/broader-functi.alignment: The summary and explanation now propose a causal relationship. Revision conditions address specified broader gains, adequate comparisons, duration, and net benefit rather than a neuromotor response alone.
src/content/model/science/broader-functi.inferenceAndImpact: P-002 supplies the outcome criterion and S-005 the input-produced changes. Even assuming S-005 true does not entail transfer. The S-007 related pair remains see-also only, with neither hypothesis establishing the other.

src/content/model/science/chiropractic-i.proposition: The approved new statement asserts beneficial neuromotor effects through perturbation for some chiropractic inputs. It is now empirical rather than mixed.
src/content/model/science/chiropractic-i.qualifiers: Some limits scope. Intended use is removed from the statement and retained as the training description in the body and A-002; selection remains prospective rather than defined by success.
src/content/model/science/chiropractic-i.evidenceSeparation: The stronger commitment is not a confidence increase. Evidence for chiropractic instantiation, beneficial change, and selection validity remains undocumented in this entry.
src/content/model/science/chiropractic-i.alignment: The title, summary, explanation, and boundary now match an effect hypothesis. Existing revision conditions test predicted changes and net-positive outcomes, so intention cannot rescue a failed effect.
src/content/model/science/chiropractic-i.inferenceAndImpact: P-002 changes from normative to conceptual for the benefit criterion; S-004 remains empirical for the mechanism. S-006, S-007, A-001, A-002, and ARG-002 were updated without inferring broader transfer, primacy, or a present matching input.

src/content/model/science/nervous-system.proposition: The empirical statement directly proposes a central integrative role for the nervous system.
src/content/model/science/nervous-system.qualifiers: Central identifies an organizing role within interacting systems, not exclusive control or universal biological primacy.
src/content/model/science/nervous-system.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved confidence and the evidence note concern the whole broad formulation; they do not make every component equally uncertain.
src/content/model/science/nervous-system.alignment: The boundary limits the integration claim, and revision conditions address specified functions. No chiropractic effect is hidden in the statement.
src/content/model/science/nervous-system.inferenceAndImpact: The entry remains an empirical root. S-007 depends on its integration account but neural integration supplies neither evidence of chiropractic effects nor their principal mediation.

src/content/model/science/neural-mediati.proposition: The approved hypothesis asserts broader chiropractic effects principally through nervous-system-mediated change.
src/content/model/science/neural-mediati.qualifiers: May is deliberately removed. Principally describes the main route, not exclusive mediation, universal success, or a beneficial value for every effect.
src/content/model/science/neural-mediati.evidenceSeparation: Confidence remains unresolved. The evidence note distinguishes missing appraisal of mediation, primacy, and particular pathways from general neural integration.
src/content/model/science/neural-mediati.alignment: The explanation now asserts both effects and principal mediation for evaluation. Separate revision conditions address mediation, competing pathways, and temporal or causal predictions.
src/content/model/science/neural-mediati.inferenceAndImpact: S-001 and S-005 retain empirical revision dependencies without proving this proposal. S-006 remains a single canonical related link; broader benefit does not establish neural primacy and mediation alone does not establish net benefit.

src/content/model/science/neuromotor-opp.proposition: The unchanged empirical statement asserts that some limiting motor strategies have a capacity for beneficial modification.
src/content/model/science/neuromotor-opp.qualifiers: Some limits the cases; can asserts modifiability rather than uncertainty. A constraint need not always offer a beneficial or actionable change.
src/content/model/science/neuromotor-opp.evidenceSeparation: The review corrected the boundary that called the statement an unresolved empirical possibility. Confidence is now explicitly unresolved for the capacity proposition; the limited force-field example remains separately appraised.
src/content/model/science/neuromotor-opp.alignment: The summary now mirrors the capacity claim. Constraint definitions remain distinct from existence and measurement evidence, and revision conditions address distinguishability, modifiability, and net benefit.
src/content/model/science/neuromotor-opp.inferenceAndImpact: P-002 supplies the benefit criterion and S-002 the domain. A-001 and ARG-002 still require detection and a matching chiropractic input in the present case. Updating the supporting text does not change the claim or entail those capabilities.

src/content/model/science/salient-pertur.proposition: The general empirical mechanism asserts capacity for sufficiently salient perturbation to prompt neuromotor reevaluation and reorganization.
src/content/model/science/salient-pertur.qualifiers: Can is retained as causal capacity. Sufficiently salient requires prospective specification independent of success; reorganization is not guaranteed or necessarily beneficial.
src/content/model/science/salient-pertur.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved confidence and the Current evidence note identify the missing claim-specific appraisal and required specification.
src/content/model/science/salient-pertur.alignment: The revised summary expresses capacity instead of a bare uncertain possibility. Its boundary now identifies S-005 as a separate chiropractic-effect hypothesis; revision conditions test the mechanism.
src/content/model/science/salient-pertur.inferenceAndImpact: S-002 remains a conceptual domain dependency and S-005 an empirical downstream dependency. A general capacity does not establish chiropractic instantiation or benefit.

src/content/model/science/state-dependen.proposition: The strengthened hypothesis asserts state-dependent variation and the occurrence of limited or poorly suited motor strategies in some circumstances.
src/content/model/science/state-dependen.qualifiers: In some circumstances replaces epistemic may with explicit scope. The summary describes context sensitivity without asserting limitation in every person or task.
src/content/model/science/state-dependen.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved confidence remains separate. The cited standing and pointing examples support context-sensitive control, not validated constraints or adjustment opportunities.
src/content/model/science/state-dependen.alignment: The boundary now identifies the proposed occurrence explicitly. Measurement requirements and revision conditions still test specified limitations against ordinary variation and error.
src/content/model/science/state-dependen.inferenceAndImpact: S-003 and S-004 retain direct conceptual dependencies for the domain. Occurring limitations establish neither beneficial modifiability nor the perturbation mechanism; no argument or bridge is added.
